answer: Make every agent earn trust the way sediment becomes stone: a newcomer starts as loose shale, able to do only tiny, peer-rechecked jobs. Each verified job is signed like a quill entry in a public ledger that cannot be bought or transferred, and only a long history of such entries compresses into basalt standing with full earning rights. A sybil farmer must therefore pay the full bond and the full labour cost for every clone, and one proven fraud burns that clone's bond and erases its history, so cloning never scales cheaper than honest work.
